capabilities: Adds a board view to Bases with group columns and sub-group rows
Edits note properties directly on cards
Reorders cards by dragging via a numeric Order property
Creates new notes in cells with chosen folder and template
Customizes cards with images, icons, colors, sizes and hidden empty properties
extras: Migrates groupOrder/subGroupOrder to columnOrder/rowOrder in .base files and embedded base blocks, including synced files; requires Obsidian 1.10.3 or later.
intentEvidence: Bases Board adds a board view to Obsidian Bases.
problem: Obsidian Bases has no board view, so notes cannot be arranged as draggable cards in columns and rows or edited visually as a Kanban or gallery.

relations.evidence: links keep their Supercharged Links styling
Choose a Folder and a Template for new notes, including Templater templates.

summary: Adds a board view to Obsidian Bases, laying notes out as Kanban or gallery cards whose drag-and-drop edits note properties.
